crosswalks.label: Industrial Engineers
crosswalks.rationale: Industrial Engineers is a bounded occupational baseline for Process Engineer; AXM profession identity/authority/maturity remain separate.

findings.summary: Process Engineering must bind improvement claims to explicit process boundaries and keep local efficiency separate from end-to-end quality, safety and human outcomes.
findings.rationale: Research-first compilation makes the boundary explicit before use.

gaps_against_body.description: Make local-versus-end-to-end optimization, control-point and shifted-failure boundaries explicit.

nonclaims: No complete Process Engineer reconstruction is claimed.
No TEST/WORKING/CANON or adjacent institutional authority is created.

high_stakes.authorization_nonclaim: No role label, package, model capability, repository permission or coordination function creates constitutional, product, professional or institutional authority.
